card.name: Words completing stock label phrases
card.fires_on: Short words in fixed label sentences, such as 'be' in 'Blood pressure should be monitored', 'which' after 'either of', and the 'ly' ending of 'Elderly' at a heading.

modes.label: Elderly heading
modes.description: The 'ly' ending of 'Elderly' when it begins a sentence about older patients.
modes.example: Geriatric Use Elder<<ly>> patients, compared to younger patients, are

modes.label: Linking word in hypertension text
modes.description: 'be' or 'which' inside stock NSAID blood pressure sentences.
modes.example: Blood pressure (BP) should<< be>> monitored closely during the initiation of NSAID

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Small words like 'can' or 'of' in the middle of a set sentence.
modes.example: the resultant CO 2 retention<< can>> further increase intracranial pressure.

card.writes: No clear meaning; it seems to push toward word-piece continuations such as 'icated' and 'ician'.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in repeated label sentences, mostly NSAID blood pressure warnings and the 'Elderly patients' heading.
